title: Monthly ST37 fallback automation
notes: Online well searches still use the live AER OneStop Well Licences layer first.
The offline ST37 fallback now looks for automatically refreshed compact ST37 files before using the older embedded snapshot.
A GitHub Actions updater now checks the official AER ST37 Excel source every day and rebuilds the fallback only when the source changes.
The Wells panel reports whether the current results came from live AER OneStop or the offline ST37 fallback.
Includes persistent one-record-per-LSD history with restored notes, saved information, first searched time, last searched time, and search count.
